source.command: python -m pytest -q tests/test_dispatcher.py tests/test_codex_adapter.py tests/test_antigravity_adapter.py tests/test_antigravity_minimax_adapter.py

claims.claim: Dispatcher and all three adapters share one NativeExecutionPolicy default of 180 response minutes and a finite 185-minute process watchdog. Direct construction is read-only, and existing Dispatcher policy imports remain compatible.
PRIMARY, REMEDIATION and REPAIR propagate the shared policy through Codex, Antigravity and Antigravity-Minimax while preserving explicit mutation grants and existing model selection.

Timeout errors distinguish the process watchdog from the response budget, preserve original captured diagnostics and exception causes, and expose unknown exit status as None. Dispatcher retains its terminal single-invocation boundary.
Successful native returns proceed directly to ResultPackage normalization without added waiting, retry, executor substitution or follow-on dispatch.

Added deterministic synthetic regressions covering all providers and operations, direct and Runtime-injected defaults, permissions, early completion, timeout diagnostics, known and unknown exit status, and preservation of explicit synthetic policies, including falsey policies.
